name: EOD 2026-09-22
body:
> Eod · Pipeliners · 2026-09-22

Tuesday. Pipeliners only: review of the outside SEO plan and the remaining city page fix.

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Reviewed the outside "SEO Low-Hanging Keyword Growth Plan" (built from a Semrush screenshot). Kept its rules (near-wins first, no doorway pages, don't rewrite winners, don't touch phone numbers) and corrected site-specific errors: 24/7 service is true; Rank Math is off and OTTO controls titles; Ads landing pages and homepage are off-limits; Florence, Apache Junction and Buckeye still being measured. Published a corrected plan.
- Most ready pages were already done Sep 19; only Goodyear remained. Goodyear now has title, H1, meta, opening sentence, FAQ heading and social previews aligned to "trenchless sewer repair in Goodyear, AZ" (checked: no paid traffic to the page).
- Cured-in-place blog post now links to the main service page (Ads page not edited). Apache Junction now links to San Tan Valley (added mid-measurement, noted).
- Wording: Laveen and Casa Grande FAQ headings to "Trenchless Sewer Repair"; San Tan Valley "Pipeliners USA" to "Pipeliners" in 2 FAQ answers.
- Rechecked the 7 pages changed Sep 19: all correct. Corrected an earlier keyword-count claim (real in-body count is 1 to 3).
- Blog: no page 2 blog keyword ready (recheck Oct 16). Myths merge put on hold (1 paid click, a typo, an unverified "50 years" claim); water-line merge waiting on Scott.
- Decisions: keep "Pipeliners USA" on the rest of the site for now; leave the two myths posts as they are.

# Follow-ups
- Checks: Sep 24 impression drop, Sep 30 Buckeye, Oct 9 (13 pages, then add Queen Creek link), Oct 12 Goodyear and blog link, Oct 16 Apache Junction, Fort McDowell and blog keywords, Oct 17 the Sep 19 batch.
